result:
I’d make high-quality education—focused on critical thinking, empathy, and practical life skills—freely available to everyone, everywhere.

It’s one change, but it would ripple into almost everything else: better health decisions, less manipulation by misinformation, more economic opportunity, more tolerance, and better collective problem-solving.
